title: kharp – k version 3 Language Interpreter in C#
summary: ksharp is a C# implementation of K version 3 programming language, an APL-family array programming language. The project provides an interpreter that brings K's powerful array manipulation capabilities to the .NET ecosystem.
problem_solved: Provides a K language interpreter implementation in C#, enabling developers familiar with .NET to use K's concise array programming paradigm
why_valuable: Offers an open-source implementation of the K language for the .NET platform, which is rare and valuable for developers interested in APL-style array programming
